title: Uniform upper amplitude of discarded proper adic truncation tails
statement: Fix universes u and u+1, a prime $\ell$, and a field $k$ in universe u whose characteristic is a positive prime different from $\ell$. Let $Z,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes, with a proper $k$-morphism $g:Z\to Y$ [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring, with its specified multiplication, certified to be one of the three adic coefficient families [def-sfb-adic-coefficient-certificate]. Put $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ and $D_T=D(\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_T})$, the ordinary unbounded module-object derived category, for $T=Z,Y$ [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. Let $\mathcal L_Z$ be the replete triangulated localizing hull of bounded constructible complexes in $D_Z$, using ambient coproducts indexed in universe u+1 [def-sfb-bounded-constructible-localizing-closure]. Write $Rg_*:D_Z\to D_Y$ for total right derived module-object pushforward. For the standard good truncation $\tau_{<a}$ [def-kun-truncations], there exists a natural number c, independent of q and K, such that for every integer q and every $K\in\mathcal L_Z$, the object $Rg_*\tau_{<q-c}K$ has cohomology only in degrees at most q-1. Equivalently, $H^r(Rg_*\tau_{<q-c}K)=0$ for every $r\ge q$. No boundedness or completeness condition is imposed on K.

source.place: Arbitrary K and the window isomorphism; integral analogue in sk-prop-int-compactness/sk-prop-int-compactness-direct-sums.proof.md, (1)-(2).

proof.text: Finite type and quasi-compactness of Y over the field give that Y is Noetherian. Eliminate the coefficient certificate and use the corresponding existing ProperLowerStarHeartHypotheses theorem. Retain its first conjunct, obtaining an integer d and a heart upper bound on S, the weak Serre coproduct closure of constructible modules.

The predicate H^*(K)∈S is replete, triangulated and closed under ambient coproducts: S is a weak Serre class closed under coproducts, and ordinary module-derived cohomology commutes with these sums. It contains bounded constructible complexes. The intersection universal property of boundedConstructibleLocalizingClosure puts every K in the hull in this predicate. Good truncation preserves the predicate, using τ<a≅τ≤a-1 and zero membership.

Put c=d.toNat+1, a=q-c and L=τ<a K. Then L is at most a-1. Each τ≥-n L is bounded with upper bound a-1 and with cohomology in S. Bounded dévissage gives Rg_*τ≥-n L at most a-1+d. The derived pushforward is triangulated and a right adjoint, hence preserves countable products; ordinary pro-etale module categories have exact countable products. Apply the existing left-completeness Milnor bound to obtain Rg_*L at most a-1+d+1. Since d≤d.toNat, this is at most q-1. This extra Milnor degree is absorbed in c; no optimality of c was asserted. The argument includes zero objects and empty fibres.

proof_origin.place: Arbitrary K and lower-tail clause, using the existing source Serre-heart inputs and coarse Milnor bound; existential c absorbs one extra degree. A6 Lean proof.

      (K : DerivedCategory (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Z.left) Ab.{u + 1})
